## Q1
What is the difference between the number of mobile phones sold by A and C together on Monday and that of D and E together on Wednesday?

| Seller | Monday | Tuesday | Wednesday | Thursday | Friday | Saturday | Sunday |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | 80 | 90 | 96 | 56 | 100 | 48 | 40 |
| B | 180 | 184 | 54 | 24 | 32 | 196 | 52 |
| C | 160 | 72 | 60 | 26 | 56 | 124 | 94 |
| D | 120 | 92 | 24 | 128 | 104 | 68 | 152 |
| E | 96 | 36 | 116 | 138 | 140 | 20 | 30 |

## Q1 - Options
(A) 120
(B) 100
(C) 160
(D) 40

## Q1 - Hint
**Answer:** B
**Topic:** Data Interpretation
**Source:** UGC NET Mar 2023 (15 Mar, Shift 1) · Paper 1 · Q1

A and C sold 80 + 160 = 240 phones on Monday. D and E sold 24 + 116 = 140 on Wednesday, so the difference is 100. This compares the two combined seller totals, so 100 is the required difference.

## Q2
The number of mobile phones sold by B on Tuesday and Saturday together is what percentage more than the number sold by C on Thursday and Sunday together?

| Seller | Monday | Tuesday | Wednesday | Thursday | Friday | Saturday | Sunday |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | 80 | 90 | 96 | 56 | 100 | 48 | 40 |
| B | 180 | 184 | 54 | 24 | 32 | 196 | 52 |
| C | 160 | 72 | 60 | 26 | 56 | 124 | 94 |
| D | 120 | 92 | 24 | 128 | 104 | 68 | 152 |
| E | 96 | 36 | 116 | 138 | 140 | 20 | 30 |

## Q2 - Options
(A) 162.33
(B) 262.67
(C) 216.67
(D) 102.67

## Q2 - Hint
**Answer:** C
**Topic:** Data Interpretation
**Source:** UGC NET Mar 2023 (15 Mar, Shift 1) · Paper 1 · Q2

B sold 184 + 196 = 380. C sold 26 + 94 = 120; the excess is 260, and 260/120 × 100 = 216.67%. The percentage base is C’s Thursday-and-Sunday mobile-phone total of 120, not B’s Tuesday-and-Saturday total.

## Q3
The number of mobile phones sold by A and D together on Wednesday is what percentage of the number sold by E on Sunday?

| Seller | Monday | Tuesday | Wednesday | Thursday | Friday | Saturday | Sunday |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | 80 | 90 | 96 | 56 | 100 | 48 | 40 |
| B | 180 | 184 | 54 | 24 | 32 | 196 | 52 |
| C | 160 | 72 | 60 | 26 | 56 | 124 | 94 |
| D | 120 | 92 | 24 | 128 | 104 | 68 | 152 |
| E | 96 | 36 | 116 | 138 | 140 | 20 | 30 |

## Q3 - Options
(A) 400
(B) 200
(C) 100
(D) 50

## Q3 - Hint
**Answer:** A
**Topic:** Data Interpretation
**Source:** UGC NET Mar 2023 (15 Mar, Shift 1) · Paper 1 · Q3

A and D sold 96 + 24 = 120 on Wednesday. E sold 30 on Sunday, so 120/30 × 100 = 400%. The calculation compares A and D on Wednesday with E on Sunday; this is why the percentage is greater than 100 rather than 100 or 200.

## Q4
What is the average sale of mobile phones by B on Wednesday, E on Sunday, and D on Monday?

| Seller | Monday | Tuesday | Wednesday | Thursday | Friday | Saturday | Sunday |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | 80 | 90 | 96 | 56 | 100 | 48 | 40 |
| B | 180 | 184 | 54 | 24 | 32 | 196 | 52 |
| C | 160 | 72 | 60 | 26 | 56 | 124 | 94 |
| D | 120 | 92 | 24 | 128 | 104 | 68 | 152 |
| E | 96 | 36 | 116 | 138 | 140 | 20 | 30 |

## Q4 - Options
(A) 48
(B) 72
(C) 60
(D) 68

## Q4 - Hint
**Answer:** D
**Topic:** Data Interpretation
**Source:** UGC NET Mar 2023 (15 Mar, Shift 1) · Paper 1 · Q4

The three values are 54, 30 and 120. Their total is 204, and 204 ÷ 3 = 68. Dividing the B-on-Wednesday, E-on-Sunday and D-on-Monday seller values gives the mean.

## Q5
Mobile phones sold by A on Thursday are Windows and Android phones in the ratio 3:4. What is the number of Windows phones?

| Seller | Monday | Tuesday | Wednesday | Thursday | Friday | Saturday | Sunday |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | 80 | 90 | 96 | 56 | 100 | 48 | 40 |
| B | 180 | 184 | 54 | 24 | 32 | 196 | 52 |
| C | 160 | 72 | 60 | 26 | 56 | 124 | 94 |
| D | 120 | 92 | 24 | 128 | 104 | 68 | 152 |
| E | 96 | 36 | 116 | 138 | 140 | 20 | 30 |

## Q5 - Options
(A) 28
(B) 48
(C) 32
(D) 24

## Q5 - Hint
**Answer:** D
**Topic:** Data Interpretation
**Source:** UGC NET Mar 2023 (15 Mar, Shift 1) · Paper 1 · Q5

A sold 56 phones on Thursday. The ratio has 7 parts, so one part is 8 and the Windows share is 3 × 8 = 24. The Windows share is three of the seven equal ratio parts.

## Q6

## Q6 - Options

(B) Allow students to do what they want.

(D) Deal with students politely and firmly.

## Q7

(D) Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct.

## Q7 - Hint
**Answer:** C
**Topic:** Teaching Aptitude
**Source:** UGC NET Mar 2023 (15 Mar, Shift 1) · Paper 1 · Q7

A plateau is a temporary flat phase in learning, showing little or no progress. It is not defined by a rise followed by a fall in the learning rate, so only Statement I is correct.

## Q21
A damaged directional pole has its north pointer pointing east, with all other pointers shifted similarly. A man follows the pointer marked west. In which actual direction is he moving?

## Q21 - Options
(A) West
(B) South
(C) East
(D) North

## Q21 - Hint
**Answer:** D
**Topic:** Mathematical Reasoning (Series, Coding, Relationships)
**Source:** UGC NET Mar 2023 (15 Mar, Shift 1) · Paper 1 · Q21

If the north pointer has rotated to east, every marked direction is 90° clockwise from its true direction. The pointer labelled West therefore physically points North.

## Q22
How many prime numbers exist between 20 and 60, and what is their average?

## Q22 - Options
(A) 7, 41.5
(B) 9, 40.33
(C) 8, 39.5
(D) 10, 42.33

## Q22 - Hint
**Answer:** B
**Topic:** Mathematical Aptitude (Arithmetic)
**Source:** UGC NET Mar 2023 (15 Mar, Shift 1) · Paper 1 · Q22

The primes are 23, 29, 31, 37, 41, 43, 47, 53 and 59: nine numbers with sum 363. Their average is 363/9 = 40.33. Listing the candidates prevents treating composite odd numbers as primes.

## Q23
The average age of seven family members is 35. Excluding one member aged 35, the other six ages are in the ratio 1:2:3:4:5:6. Find the eldest age.

## Q23 - Options
(A) 60 years
(B) 65 years
(C) 61 years
(D) 58 years

## Q23 - Hint
**Answer:** A
**Topic:** Mathematical Aptitude (Arithmetic)
**Source:** UGC NET Mar 2023 (15 Mar, Shift 1) · Paper 1 · Q23

The total age is 7 × 35 = 245; after excluding 35, the six ages total 210. Their ratio total is 21, so one unit is 10 and the eldest is 6 × 10 = 60. The ratio distributes the remaining total into 21 equal units.

## Q24
If A is coded as C, B as D, C as E and so on, code “CONFIDENTIAL”.

## Q24 - Options
(A) EQPHKFGKVNC
(B) EQRIKFHQWLEN
(C) DQQHLFGPWLDN
(D) EQPHKFGPVKCN

## Q24 - Hint
**Answer:** D
**Topic:** Mathematical Reasoning (Series, Coding, Relationships)
**Source:** UGC NET Mar 2023 (15 Mar, Shift 1) · Paper 1 · Q24

Each letter is shifted forward by two: C→E, O→Q, N→P and so on. Applying this consistently gives EQPHKFGPVKCN. Every letter, including repeated letters, receives the same two-place shift.

## Q25
Which number replaces the question mark in the series 1, 7, 17, 31, ?, 71?

## Q25 - Options
(A) 47
(B) 49
(C) 41
(D) 60

## Q25 - Hint
**Answer:** B
**Topic:** Mathematical Reasoning (Series, Coding, Relationships)
**Source:** UGC NET Mar 2023 (15 Mar, Shift 1) · Paper 1 · Q25

The increments are +6, +10, +14, +18 and +22, increasing by four each time. Thus the missing number is 31 + 18 = 49. The steadily increasing gaps are the key pattern in the series.

## Q26
“Mr. Kubra is a murderer because he wrongfully killed someone.” Which fallacy is committed?

## Q26 - Options
(A) Begging the question
(B) Ad hominem
(C) Hasty generalisation
(D) Equivocation

## Q26 - Hint
**Answer:** A
**Topic:** Logical Reasoning (Venn, Syllogism, Arguments)
**Source:** UGC NET Mar 2023 (15 Mar, Shift 1) · Paper 1 · Q26

The premise simply restates what the conclusion means: someone who wrongfully killed someone is called a murderer. The argument assumes the point it is meant to prove, which is begging the question.

## Q27
Which statement is logically equivalent to “Some plants are carnivorous organisms”?

## Q27 - Options
(A) No carnivorous organisms are plants.
(B) Some plants are non-carnivorous organisms.
(C) No plants are non-carnivorous organisms.
(D) Some plants are not non-carnivorous organisms.

## Q27 - Hint
**Answer:** D
**Topic:** Logical Reasoning (Venn, Syllogism, Arguments)
**Source:** UGC NET Mar 2023 (15 Mar, Shift 1) · Paper 1 · Q27

“Some plants are carnivorous” means at least one plant is not non-carnivorous. Double negation converts “not non-carnivorous” into carnivorous, so option D is equivalent.

## Q28
“Supporters of party ABC oppose gun control, and Republicans also oppose gun control; therefore some Republicans support ABC.” Identify the fallacy.

## Q28 - Options
(A) Affirming the consequent
(B) Denying the antecedent
(C) Ad hominem
(D) Undistributed middle

## Q28 - Hint
**Answer:** D
**Topic:** Logical Reasoning (Venn, Syllogism, Arguments)
**Source:** UGC NET Mar 2023 (15 Mar, Shift 1) · Paper 1 · Q28

Sharing a property does not establish overlap between two groups. “Opposes gun control” is the undistributed middle term, so the conclusion about common membership does not follow.

## Q29
Which statements are contrary to each other?

A. All human beings are mortal.<br>
B. No human beings are mortal.<br>
C. Some human beings are mortal.<br>
D. Some human beings are not mortal.

Choose the correct answer.

## Q29 - Options
(A) A and D only
(B) B and C only
(C) A and B only
(D) A and C only

## Q29 - Hint
**Answer:** C
**Topic:** Logical Reasoning (Venn, Syllogism, Arguments)
**Source:** UGC NET Mar 2023 (15 Mar, Shift 1) · Paper 1 · Q29

Contraries cannot both be true but can both be false. The universal affirmative A and universal negative B are contraries; the “some” statements are subcontraries or contradictories of the universals.

## Q46
In October, the index of industrial production fell by

Annual consumer price index (CPI) inflation fell to 5.88 percent in November from 6.77 percent in October, below the RBI’s 6 percent upper tolerance limit for the first time since December 2021. The index of industrial production (IIP) contracted 4 percent year-on-year in October, led by manufacturing (minus 5.6 percent), consumer durables (minus 15.3 percent), non-durables (minus 13.4 percent) and capital goods (minus 2.3 percent). **Answer:** C

**Source:** UGC NET Mar 2023 (15 Mar, Shift 1) · Paper 1 · Q46

The passage explicitly states that IIP contracted by 4% year on year in October. The 5.6% figure refers specifically to manufacturing, while 5.88% and 6.77% are CPI-inflation figures.
